pages.title: Widget API keys
pages._note: Key-management console for the public self-service booking widget: it mints, rotates and revokes a widget API key for a (businessId, administrationId) pair against the widget-key endpoints, and shows the generated key exactly once. The key is a credential, not an OpenRegister object the viewer may list — no index/detail/form page type can express a write-only secret whose value is returned once and never readable again.
